threads.body: Changelog fragment filenames use `+.<type>.md` only when there is no PR number yet. Since this change is already in a PR, please rename this fragment to `<pr-number>.enhancement.md` (or `<pr-number>.enhancement.<counter>.md`).

`_MODALITY_MAP` includes `VIDEO` and `DOCUMENT`, but this PR intentionally does not define any `gen_ai.usage.video.*` / `gen_ai.usage.document.*` attributes in the registry. If Vertex returns those modalities, this scenario would emit undefined attribute keys. Consider limiting the map to the modalities that are actually defined by the conventions in this PR (text/image/audio).

threads.body: Where did we settle on including these on the agent spans and overcounting issues when doing rollups?

replies.body:
good point. I removed new attributes from internal span, but kept on the client spans.

I don't believe we landed anywhere on https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/issues/19

so just not making it worse for now by not including breakdowns on internal agents

threads.body:
Should the note on `gen_ai.usage.<modality>.cache_read.input_tokens` also mention that it's included in `gen_ai.usage.<modality>.input_tokens`?

Right now it only mentions `gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens`. For reference, that's what we do in:
- `reference/src/semconv_genai/mock_server/google_genai.py:155-158` (cached tokens are modeled as a subset of prompt tokens)
- `reference/scenarios/google-genai/scenario.py:88-101` (mapping `prompt_tokens_details` to `<modality>.input_tokens` and `cache_tokens_details` to `<modality>.cache_read.input_tokens`)
- #374 ("Each detailed attribute is a subset of its aggregate")

```yaml
    note: >
      The value SHOULD be included in `gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens` and in `gen_ai.usage.<modality>.input_tokens`.
```
